verses: Yaqeenan hum ney ussay shab qadar mein nazil farmaya
To kiya samjha kay shab qadar kiya hai?
Shab qadar aik hazar maheenon say behtar hai
Uss (mein her kaam) kay sir anjam denay ko apney rab kay hukum say farishtay aur rooh (Jibraeel) utartay hain
Yeh raat sirasir salamti ki hoti hai aur fajar kay tuloo honey tak (rehti hai)
